description: Call this when a homeowner asks about the assessed value of a SPECIFIC address, whether their assessment is too high, or what their home is worth. Reads the OPEN assessment rolls (Quebec: 1,113 municipalities; Nova Scotia; New Brunswick; Winnipeg; Calgary, Edmonton, Lethbridge, Strathcona, Okotoks, Grande Prairie, St. Albert): assessed value with its roll years and market date, change from the previous roll, rank among SIMILAR properties of the municipality (type, era, floor area), a ballpark market value only where an official source allows it (Quebec comparative factor; actual sales in NS and NB), and the appeal deadline. Public figures compared, never an opinion of value. No owner names. Other provinces have no open roll by address.

adresse.description: Civic address, number first, e.g. "9060 boul. Lévesque E" or "1200 rue Saint-Alexandre, app. 305".

municipalite.description: Municipality as named in the roll, e.g. "Laval", "Halifax Regional Municipality", "Calgary", "Winnipeg".

province.description: Province name or code (QC, NS, NB, AB, MB).

name: evaluation_adresse
title: Évaluation foncière à une adresse / Property assessment at an address
